title: 第17章 小有所成第18章 临青石镇
content_zh:
“越难，说明武技越不一般，想要到达七拳叠加或许要很久，但稳固境界，参加大比，时间应该很够！”
江若尘稍作休息，而后再次起身，舞动起了拳法。
他的身体素质，以及力量均已经达到，接下来便是全力练习【象龙拳】入门篇的精髓，象龙七拳。
这七拳是入门篇的精髓，练习的难度更高，需要在轰出第一拳时借势，在极速之间再打出第二拳，让两拳的力量快速重合，以此打出翻倍力量的效果。
理论简单，可要想做到这一点是非常难的。
江若尘又在空间内整整练习了数十天，才终于第一次摸到了重合的门槛。
他身体下沉，气息提升，力量被他催发到极致的轰出了第一拳，而后以肉眼不可见的速度收拳，出拳。
两拳叠加，力量瞬间融合炸开，巨大的力量都让空间微微荡漾！
江若尘估计，起码有五象之力！
之所以只有五象之力，是因为江若尘此时只做到了两拳融合，并没有真正做到第二拳出拳时，依旧是全力发挥，所以才没有成倍的增长。
可即便如此也是相当的恐怖了，一个五重天的修士一拳打出足以碾压普通九重天的五象之力，多么夸张？
呼呼……
两拳重合成功，江若尘来不及欣喜，一股剧痛突然从他的臂膀传入身体，快速的抽走了他的绝大部分力气。
险些让他一个趔趄没站稳，直接倒下……
这是因为，【象龙拳】重叠起来的威力巨大，对身体的损耗也是巨大的，外加江若尘本就苦练了很长一段时间，身体根本承受不起这么大的损耗。
“真是变态武技啊，力量变态，练习难度变态，损耗更是变态。”
江若尘捂着刚才出拳的臂膀，龇牙咧嘴得吐槽。
不知是巧合，还是听到了江若尘的吐槽，老龙突然从葬神塔浮现。
“很不错，才十多日就能让两拳重合，也算堪堪合格了，虽然第二拳出时并未使出全力，可也勉强凑齐了五象之力，足以灭杀绝大部分九重天的修士！”
老龙道。

江若尘闻声看去：“前辈，这武技也太变态了，有没有什么办法能减少力量的损耗，否则哪怕我满状态，最多打出两次这样的效果就要力竭！”
“有。”
老龙干脆回答。
“什么办法？”
江若尘一脸期待。
“提升实力，提升体魄承受力，多练习【象龙拳】。”
老龙一本正经的回答。
江若尘：“……”
这些办法还用你说？江若尘心里狠狠吐槽。
“好了，【象龙拳】既已经入门，出葬神塔去寻找高强度实战处吧，葬神塔能为你提供更多的闭关时间，可始终待在此处无异于闭门造车，要想战力无双，境界稳固，实战必不可少！”
老龙道。
闻言，江若尘露出无奈的表情道，“前辈，小子倒是也想去实战一番，只是王城严禁动武，真要想磨炼一番，就得去城外的魔兽森林，以我现在的处境，怕是出城容易，回来难。”
“你担心的可是王后？依我看，无须顾虑，在她眼里，你依旧是个废物，对你动手她怎会大动干戈？若真有气海境出手，本尊自有手段灭杀！”
content_en:
"The more difficult it is, the more extraordinary the martial arts are. It may take a long time to reach the superposition of seven punches, but if you stabilize your state and participate in the competition, you should have enough time!"
Jiang Ruochen took a short rest, then stood up again and began to dance with his fists.
His physical fitness and strength have been reached, and the next step is to practice the essence of the introductory chapter of [Elephant Dragon Fist], the Seven Fists of the Elephant Dragon.
These seven punches are the essence of the introductory chapter. They are more difficult to practice. You need to take advantage of the momentum when throwing the first punch, and then hit the second punch at extreme speed, so that the power of the two punches can quickly overlap, thereby doubling the power.
The theory is simple, but it is very difficult to do this.
Jiang Ruochen practiced in the space for dozens of days before finally touching the threshold of overlap for the first time.
His body sank, his aura increased, and his strength was pushed to the extreme. He punched out the first punch, then retracted and punched out at a speed invisible to the naked eye.
The two punches were superimposed, and the power instantly merged and exploded. The huge power made the space ripple slightly!
Jiang Ruochen estimated that he had at least the power of the Five Symbols!
The reason why there is only the power of the Five Symbols is because Jiang Ruochen only managed to fuse the two punches at this time, and did not really use his full strength when the second punch was thrown, so it did not increase exponentially.
But even this is quite terrifying. How exaggerated is it for a monk from the fifth heaven to punch out five images that are enough to crush the ordinary ninth heaven?
Huhu...
The two punches overlapped successfully. Jiang Ruochen had no time to rejoice when a sharp pain suddenly passed from his arm into his body, quickly taking away most of his strength.
He almost staggered and fell down...
This is because the overlapping power of [Elephant Dragon Fist] is huge, and the damage to the body is also huge. In addition, Jiang Ruochen has been practicing hard for a long time, and his body simply cannot bear such a huge loss.
"What a perverted martial art. The strength is perverted, the difficulty of practice is perverted, and the wear and tear is even more perverted."
Jiang Ruochen covered the arm where he punched just now, grinning and complaining.
I don't know if it was a coincidence, or he heard Jiang Ruochen's complaints, but the old dragon suddenly emerged from the God Burial Tower.
"It's very good. It only took more than ten days to make the two punches overlap, which is considered qualified. Although the second punch was not used with all the strength, it still managed to gather the power of the five elephants, which is enough to kill most of the monks in the ninth heaven!"
Old Long said.
Jiang Ruochen heard the sound and looked over: "Senior, this martial art is too abnormal. Is there any way to reduce the loss of power? Otherwise, even if I am at full status, I will be exhausted after performing this effect twice at most!"
"Yes."
Lao Long answered simply.
"What can I do?"
Jiang Ruochen looked expectant.
"Improve your strength, improve your physical endurance, and practice [Elephant Dragon Fist] more."
Lao Long answered seriously.
Jiang Ruochen: "..."
Do you still need to tell me these methods? Jiang Ruochen complained bitterly in his heart.
"Okay, now that you have started using [Elephant Dragon Fist], let's go out of the God Burial Tower to find a place for high-intensity actual combat. The God Burial Tower can provide you with more retreat time, but staying here all the time is tantamount to working behind closed doors. If you want to have unparalleled combat power and a stable realm, actual combat is essential!"
Old Long said.
Hearing this, Jiang Ruochen showed a helpless expression and said, "Senior, I also want to have some actual combat. However, the use of force is strictly prohibited in the royal city. If you really want to practice, you have to go to the Warcraft Forest outside the city. With my current situation, I am afraid it will be easier to leave the city than to come back."
"Is it the queen you are worried about? In my opinion, there is no need to worry. In her eyes, you are still a waste. How can she go to war against you? If there is a Qi Sea Realm, I will have my own means to kill you!"
